title: Only for red wine and non screw tops
text: Only for red wine and non screw tops. It does not work for all wine bottles either screw tops or white wine: just too big.  Otherwise for red wine, if you only plan to keep for another couple of days, great and easy to use.  Neat and compact versus larger vacuum contraptions we have at home. I only wished the cork was more flexible to use on smaller bottle necks.

description: Genuine Fred CORKY seals your opened wine bottle as the ultimate fun wine preserver. Looking to keep the zest in your zin, the mmmm in your merlot? Put a cork in it! Even better, insert Corky and give it a few presses to evacuate the air trapped inside the bottle. Voila! Corky is made from durable, food-safe plastic that keeps your wine fresh as can be, even though you haven't finished it.
